terjemah: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Yahya bin Yahya] dia berkata; saya membacakan di hadapan [Malik]; dari [Nafi'] dari [Abdullah bin Umar] dia berkata, "Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam melarang membawa mushaf Al Qur'an ke daerah musuh."
arab: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُسَافَرَ بِالْقُرْآنِ إِلَى أَرْضِ الْعَدُوِّ ‏.‏
english: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar who said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade that one should travel to the land of the enemy taking the Qur'an with him
